name: Florida Championship 2026

venue.name: Donald L. Tucker Civic Center
venue.details: Enter the Donald L. Tucker Center through the main doors and proceed down the escalator to the lower level to Meeting Room A for main events and Meeting Room C for side events

information:
Welcome to Florida Championship 2026, the first official championship in Florida Cubing History!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg4NDkyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a66561e38a93403fb34b5d6f5aa69e81e92153eb/FC_Logo.png)
All competitors who officially [**declare their residency on their CubingUSA account**](https://cubingusa.org/edit) in Florida by **Friday, August 28, 2026 at 8:00 PM Eastern** will be eligible for inaugural Florida Champion titles. Please note that you may be asked to verify your residency at the competition with identifying documentation if you achieve a Florida Champion title.

[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)](https://southeastcubing.org/about)

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FloridaChampionship2026#73966-southeast-cubing-inc-florida-cubing) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
